data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'zyn', meaning 'graceful' or 'delicate', Muzaynah embodies the essence of feminine beauty and elegance. In Islamic tradition, this name symbolizes the virtues of patience, kindness, and inner strength. The name Muzaynah carries the meaning “Graceful, Delicate, Beautiful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Muzaynah usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful, delicate, beautiful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
